THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. DEFENDANT, DONNA VALENZUELA, OWES PLAINTIFF, DON SEYRANIAN. A TOTAL OF $2,919.00. THIS AMOUNT INCLUDES ATTORNEY'S FEES OF $699.00 AS WELL AS BACK RENT AND DAMAGES. ON A WEEKLY BASIS, DEFENDANT VALENZUELA WILL PAY $150.00. THE $150.00 WILL BE RECEIVED AT PLAINTIFF'S PLACE OF BUSINESS EACH FRIDAY. THE FIRST PAYMENT WILL BE DUE 5-19-95 AND EVERY FRIDAY THEREAFTER. ON WEDNESDAY OF EACH WEEK, DEFENDANT VALENZUELA WILL CALL PLAINTIFF SEYRANIAN TO INFORM HIM SHE HAS MAILED HIM HIS CHECK. WHEN BACK RENT, DAMAGES AND ATTORNEY'S FEES ARE PAID, DEFENDANT VALENZUELA WILL PAY RENT ACCORDING TO HER LEASE. RENT MUST BE PAID ON TIME. IF DEFENDANT VALENZUELA IS TWO DAYS LATE WITH A PAYMENT, WHATEVER MONIES ARE OUTSTANDING, WILL BE DUE AND OWING. PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEY MAY REQUEST A WRIT BY EX PARTE MOTION.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VALENZUELA, DONNA THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 19 HOMESTEAD STREET, SAN FRANCISCO $2,919.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,919.00, LEASE FORFEITED, DEFENDANT, DONNA VALENZUELA, PER STIPULATION, IS TO MAKE PAYMENTS ON THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF RENT AND DAMAGES OWED -- $2,919.00. IF A WRIT ISSUES IN THIS MATTER, THE AMOUNT OWED MAY BE LESS THAN $2,919.00.
